_doc: THE SOURCE CATALOG of Capital-Stack-FinTerminal (#1335), modelled on FinceptTerminal (open source, Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal; public feeds + your own API keys, 100+ connectors: FRED, DBnomics, IMF, World Bank, Polygon, Databento, Deribit, news, RSS, geopolitical, AIS). Everything the app knows about a data source is here and nowhere else: Kotlin names no address. Read by Catalog.kt (Config > Sources, the dashboards) and by test/test-finterm-sources.sh, which holds it to build.json::ui.stacks and data/dashboards.json.
_doc_fields: id: stable key (also the key slot of the stored API key). name, category (FI-Macro | Equity-Exchange | Options | News-Alt), coverage: one line. endpoint: base address ('' when the user maps it: user_endpoint true). docs: the provider's documentation. auth.type: none | free_key | paid; auth.key_in: where a key goes when the connector is wired (query | header | basic | oauth | message) and its name; auth.signup: where to get a free key. connector: the Kotlin provider that fetches it live (Providers.kt: fred_series, dbnomics_series, imf_datamapper, worldbank_indicator, gdelt_artlist) or null while only the placeholder layout exists. feeds: the FinTerm tab (build.json::ui bottom_nav id) and the entry titles of that tab this source feeds ('*' = every entry of the tab): EVERY entry must be fed by at least one source (the guard). priority: lower is tried first (the source order of a panel: the highest-priority source that feeds the entry and declares a primary route for the panel, then the panel's own source as fallback). primary: true marks THE primary source (Cloud-Fincept, shown first in Config > Sources with its container control). fleet_endpoint: the id in ac_cloud-account/build.json::fleet_endpoints whose MESH base address app/build.gradle bakes (FLEET_MESH_B64), so no mesh address is typed anywhere. paths: the source's declared API paths under that base. container: the id of the container in data/control.json. attribution: shown on the source's card (open-source upstream and its licence). cors: false when the source sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, so a BROWSER cannot read it (the web terminal then skips it straight to the next source; the APK is not a browser and ignores the flag); absent or true = readable from a browser.
_doc_keys: Stored on this phone only, in EncryptedSharedPreferences under an Android Keystore AES-256-GCM key (libs:crash SafeEncryptedPrefs); never logged, never in git, never sent anywhere but this source.

sources.name: Cloud-Fincept / fin_api (private mesh)
sources.coverage: The FinceptTerminal backend (capital-stack-finterminal-api) running on oci-apps: 35 data connectors (FRED, DBnomics, IMF, World Bank, Polygon, Yahoo, Kraken, ...), 7 analytics modules, 17 brokers, 6 investor personas, MCP tools, behind one DataHub. PRIMARY source of every FinTerm entry while the phone is on the mesh. The /v1 surface (design 3.2: series, curves, quotes, calendars, fundamentals, normalised) is the declared first source of every panel that names it as fetch.primary.api.

auth.note: Private WireGuard mesh only (the mesh name resolves nowhere else); no key, no public route. Off the mesh every dashboard falls back to the public sources.

sources.service: cloud-u-containers/user-fin_capital-stack-finterminal-api (container capital-stack-finterminal-api on oci-apps, image ghcr.io/diegonmarcos/capital-stack-finterminal-api, port 8340, mesh name capital-stack-finterminal-api.mesh.diegonmarcos.com)
sources.attribution: FinceptTerminal (upstream, Fincept Corporation), AGPL-3.0; this fleet runs its Rust port as capital-stack-finterminal-api

sources.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
sources.coverage: US Treasury par yields DGS1MO-DGS30, policy and overnight rates (SOFR, EFFR, IORB), H.10 FX, major equity index levels, macro indicators; 800k+ series

auth.note: The public fredgraph.csv endpoint needs no key (one request per series; the date window is honoured for a single series only).

sources.cors_note: fred.stlouisfed.org sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header: a browser cannot read it, so the web terminal skips it straight to the next source. The APK is not a browser and reads it.

sources.name: DBnomics
sources.coverage: 100M+ series from 90+ providers: central bank policy rates (BIS), OECD long-term government yields, international macro; the Federal Reserve H.15 (Treasury constant maturities, effective Fed funds, prime) and H.10 (FX) mirrors, which allow browser (CORS) requests, as the second source behind FRED

auth.note: Public API, no key.

sources.name: IMF DataMapper
sources.coverage: World Economic Outlook indicators for ~200 countries, including general government gross debt (% of GDP)

auth.note: Public API, no key.

sources.cors_note: www.imf.org sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header: a browser cannot read it, so the web terminal shows the panel as a placeholder without asking. The APK is not a browser and reads it.

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.coverage: Development and macro indicators for 200+ economies (inflation, debt, growth)

auth.note: Public API, no key.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage
sources.coverage: Custom provider: FX, equities, Treasury yields and economic indicators (free tier is rate limited)

auth.note: Free key from the sign-up page.

sources.name: Premium fixed-income feed (custom)
sources.coverage: Your own paid fixed-income provider (rate-futures implied probabilities, sovereign curves, onshore USD rates): you map its endpoint and key

auth.note: Bring your own subscription; the feed is mapped by you, nothing is shipped.

sources.name: Fincept Data API
sources.coverage: Aggregator of 2,000+ sources and 423k instruments across NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, CBOE and OTC; 500+ REST endpoints, free tier

auth.note: Free Fincept account key; Pro raises the limits.

sources.name: Polygon.io
sources.coverage: Real-time and historical US equities, options, FX and crypto; custom provider with your key

auth.note: Free plan key (delayed, rate limited); real-time is paid.

sources.name: Databento
sources.coverage: Institutional market data with L2 depth (MBP/MBO) for US equities and futures

auth.note: Paid, usage billed by Databento; the key is the HTTP basic user.

sources.name: Deribit
sources.coverage: Crypto options and futures: instruments, order books, implied volatility, Greeks

auth.note: Public market data needs no auth; a free API client id/secret unlocks account data and higher limits.

sources.name: GDELT
sources.coverage: Global news events and articles in 100+ languages, updated every 15 minutes (DOC 2.0 API)

auth.note: Public API, no key; one request every 5 seconds.

sources.name: Custom RSS feeds
sources.coverage: Any RSS/Atom feed you map (central banks, wires, blogs)

auth.note: You supply the feed address; an optional key is kept like any other.

sources.name: Government releases (Federal Reserve press feed)
sources.coverage: Official press releases: Federal Reserve monetary policy and regulatory statements (RSS); more agencies are added by mapping their feeds

auth.note: Public RSS, no key.

sources.name: ACLED (geopolitical tracker)
sources.coverage: Armed conflict and protest events worldwide, geocoded and dated

auth.note: Free researcher key plus the e-mail it was issued to.

sources.name: AISstream (maritime AIS vessel tracking)
sources.coverage: Live AIS vessel positions worldwide (terrestrial and satellite), WebSocket stream

auth.note: Free key; sent in the first WebSocket message.

sources.name: NY Fed Markets API
sources.coverage: Reference rates published by the New York Fed: SOFR, EFFR, OBFR, TGCR, BGCR and the SOFR 30/90/180-day averages and index, with percentiles and volumes

auth.note: Public API, no key.

sources.licence: NY Fed terms of use, attribution

sources.name: US Treasury par yield curve (XML)
sources.coverage: The official daily Treasury par yield curve 1M-30Y, same day 15:30 ET (also real yields and bill rates)

auth.note: Public XML feed, no key.

sources.name: ECB Data Portal
sources.coverage: Euro area AAA government yield curve (YC), ECB policy rates (FM), euro reference exchange rates (EXR)

auth.note: Public SDMX API, no key.

sources.name: OECD Data Explorer (SDMX)
sources.coverage: G7/G20 consumer prices, unemployment and key economic indicators

auth.note: Public SDMX API, no key; under 60 requests a minute.

sources.name: Eurostat
sources.coverage: Euro area and EU member HICP inflation, unemployment, GDP (JSON-stat)

auth.note: Public API, no key.

sources.name: BLS Public Data API v2
sources.coverage: US CPI, core CPI, nonfarm payrolls, unemployment rate: the official print, the morning of the release

auth.note: No key: 25 requests a day per address (a free key raises it to 500; the container holds it).

sources.name: BLS release schedule (iCalendar)
sources.coverage: The scheduled date and time of every BLS news release (CPI, Employment Situation, PPI, JOLTS, ...)

auth.note: Public calendar file, no key.

sources.name: Forex Factory weekly calendar (Fair Economy)
sources.coverage: This week's G10 + China economic events: time, country, impact, forecast (consensus), previous

auth.note: Public feed, no key; it answers 429 to a second request within a minute: read at most every 15 minutes (the container's job; the phone keeps the answer 15 minutes).

sources.licence: Forex Factory terms: personal use, attribution shown

sources.name: Central bank meeting calendar (declared)
sources.coverage: Policy decision days of the Fed, ECB, BoE and BoJ, from each bank's published schedule (data/central-banks.json)

auth.note: Declared in this app; nothing is fetched.

sources.name: Polymarket (Gamma API)
sources.coverage: Market-implied probabilities: Fed decision by meeting, number of cuts this year

auth.note: Public read API, no key.

sources.name: Frankfurter (ECB reference rates)
sources.coverage: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates, daily around 16:00 CET, any base currency, with history

auth.note: Public API, no key.

sources.name: Coinbase Exchange public market data
sources.coverage: Crypto spot: 24h open/high/low/last and daily candles for BTC, ETH, SOL and every listed pair

auth.note: Public market data, no key.

sources.name: Cboe delayed quotes
sources.coverage: 15-minute delayed quotes for US indices (SPX, NDX, DJX, RUT, VIX) and any listed stock or ETF, with daily history

auth.note: Public delayed data, no key; sends no CORS header (the APK reads it, the web through the container).

sources.licence: Cboe delayed data: personal display, 15-minute delay stated

sources.name: SEC EDGAR submissions
sources.coverage: Company profile (name, tickers, exchange, industry, fiscal year end) and every filing (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, ...) with its link

auth.note: Public API, no key; at most 10 requests a second.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR XBRL facts
sources.coverage: Reported financial facts per company and concept (revenue, net income, EPS, cash flow) by fiscal year

auth.note: Public API, no key; sends no CORS header (the APK reads it, the web through the container).

sources.name: Nasdaq earnings calendar
sources.coverage: Earnings reports by day: company, time (before open / after close), EPS consensus, last year's EPS, market cap

auth.note: Public site API, no key; best effort (no CORS header: the APK reads it, the web through the container).

sources.name: Finnhub
sources.coverage: Real-time US quotes, company metrics, earnings calendar with EPS estimate and actual

auth.note: Free key, 60 requests a minute, personal use.

sources.name: EIA Open Data v2
sources.coverage: WTI, Brent, Henry Hub spot and futures, inventories

auth.note: Free key.

_doc_priority: Cloud-Fincept (0) first when the phone reaches the mesh; the key-free public sources (10) next; the keyed ones (20) last. A panel falls back series by series: a topic the container has not published (404) is read from the public source.
_doc_fin_api: Cloud-Fincept and the owner's `fin_api` are ONE service: the FinceptTerminal Rust backend declared in cloud-u-containers/user-fin_capital-stack-finterminal-api (build.json name capital-stack-finterminal-api, 'Fincept Terminal backend'). Its retired public host answers 302 to sign-in (#1104); the declared private forms are the mesh name (capital-stack-finterminal-api.mesh.diegonmarcos.com:8340, 10.0.0.6) and the c3-pvt path; the app uses the mesh only. Own-fleet sources (priority 0) are tried before the public ones (10) and the keyed ones (20): what each serves decides it, and fin_api serves every connector the public ones do plus the analytics.
_doc_v1: New connectors (design 2, M0-M3): every one parses its answer into the normalised model of Feeds.kt / engine.ts (points, events, bars, rows) and the panel's derive (points | events | candles | kv | filings) renders it. cors false = no Access-Control-Allow-Origin: the web never asks it (container or the next route). schedule.ttl_s = how long an answer is kept (the phone's cache, the container's refresh); rate_limit = the provider's stated limit. endpoint 'asset:' = a file declared in this app's data/ folder.
